'''Corporate Arrivals Plaza''' was the plaza located outside of [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]], a major [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[Incorporation Islands]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. The plaza also featured the [[Incorporation Islands Tram Station|region's main station]] for the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[rocket tram]] system.<ref name="TOR" />
